# scm_dlp_tenant_channels (Data Source)

Retrieves effective/licensed Enterprise DLP channels for the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the DLP channels the tenant is licensed for.
data "scm_dlp_tenant_channels" "active" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Map of Boolean) Map of channel name to enablement flag (e.g. prisma-access: true).
- `tfid` (String) Terraform identifier.
